Trump's Big Bill for Billionaires doesn't just kick millions of people off Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act — it forces catastrophic cuts to Medicare.

While Republicans give billionaires and big corporations tax breaks, hospitals across America would close their doors. https://t.co/k9Q5KAzGbF

The 17 MILLION Americans you’re kicking off their health insurance aren’t “minutiae.”

Republicans are about to force the largest loss of health care in American history — and they clearly couldn’t care less about working families.

The people Trump and Republicans are attacking with their Big, Ugly Bill are our friends and neighbors.

If they pass this bill, families across Pennsylvania will suffer:

❌ 483,868 people across Pennsylvania will lose health insurance
❌ Hospitals across our state will be at risk of closing their doors
❌ At least 143,000 people across Pennsylvania could lose some or all food assistance
❌ 37,000 manufacturing and energy jobs in Pennsylvania would be eliminated
❌ $360 average yearly increase in energy bills for Pennsylvania families
❌ 123,665 students in Pennsylvania could have their Pell grants cut or eliminated entirely

It's truly evil to punish this many people to give tax breaks to billionaires — and I won't stop fighting back.

Trump said he would "love and cherish" Medicaid.

We all know what happens when Donald Trump promises to love and cherish anyone or anything.

Republicans are trying to kick millions of Americans off their health care and make the largest cut to Medicaid in history today.

Trump's Big, Ugly Bill will hurt Americans from coast to coast.

In Nebraska, a health clinic is already closing because of his Medicaid cuts. 

Republicans knew this would happen, but they did it anyway to give billionaires more tax breaks. https://t.co/NQBwILFgY7

Trump's Big Ugly Law will kick 17 million Americans off their health care.

44% of our neighbors here in Philly count on Medicaid.

Even if you aren't on Medicaid, these cuts will force health centers, nursing homes, and hospitals to close.

It's just plain wrong. https://t.co/HlATELULmT

Medicare and Medicaid are a sacred promise, keeping millions of families healthy.

Here in Philly, 44% of our neighbors count on Medicaid.

I grew up in a working family, and I know how important that security is. I will always fight to defend your health care.

Today, Medicare and Medicaid turn 60. Both are under attack from Trump's Big Ugly Law.

Trump's law kicks MILLIONS of Americans off Medicaid, and triggers $500 BILLION in cuts to Medicare.

Why? So billionaires can get more tax breaks. It's shameful.

Hospital bills don't care if you're a Democrat or Republican.

Protecting Medicare and Medicaid should be a bipartisan issue.

But as I shared with @6abc recently, Trump and Republicans are selling out the middle class to give tax breaks to their billionaire friends. https://t.co/yEzG1TNE6f

Trump is making Social Security's finances worse with his tax breaks for billionaires.

But Social Security doesn't need to go bankrupt.

Instead, my Medicare and Social Security Fair Share Act would save these hard-earned benefits by making the ultra-rich pay their fair share.

Learn more about how my bill will save Social Security and Medicare:

https://t.co/6i602WwNvC

Social Security is the greatest anti-poverty program in American history. For 90 years, it has enabled millions to retire with dignity.

My Medicare and Social Security Fair Share Act would protect that promise for all generations by making the mega-rich pay their fair share. https://t.co/PT5zU2e9qI

🚨 I asked the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office to investigate Trump's Big Ugly Law.

They just confirmed it triggers over half a TRILLION dollars in Medicare cuts.

Apparently for Donald Trump, the largest Medicaid cuts in history weren't enough.

No mother should have to drive up to 100 miles to get care for themselves and their child.

Trump's anti-family Big Bill for Billionaires will make it even harder for moms to get the care they need with the largest Medicaid cuts in history.

https://t.co/NNgEHvIG8D

I won’t stand by while Republicans rip health care from my neighbors in Philly and hardworking families across America.

Trump’s health care crisis is kicking millions off coverage, jacking up costs for millions more, and padding the pockets of his billionaire buddies. It's vile. https://t.co/3dQX4zm2Pf
See how many people will lose coverage and how much health care costs will rise in your community due to the Republican health care crisis: https://t.co/rVuhpe6BAY

Trump and Republicans refuse to negotiate and have canceled session again this week. 

Republicans don't want to reopen the government — they are happy to kick millions of Americans off their health care and let premiums skyrocket for millions more. https://t.co/BchPh3c7yf

My team had a wonderful time at @SenTartaglione's Senior Expo, sharing information on Medicare & Social Security.

If you ever need help with these programs or other federal agencies, please give us a call or visit my website: https://t.co/KAiOWGiU7R https://t.co/HHFp8bc9T1

We're over a week into an entirely avoidable Republican shutdown. 

But they refuse to negotiate because they don't care about the consequences.

My neighbors can't wait — premiums are rising right now. Pennsylvanians can't afford even higher health care prices. https://t.co/fM93lHqtii

My position is clear: I will not allow Republicans to raise health care costs and slash coverage for millions of Americans while they give billionaires even bigger tax breaks.

I work for the hardworking people of Pennsylvania, NOT the ultra-rich. https://t.co/xdvi9DjNGN

Across America, families are learning that their premiums are skyrocketing. For one couple in Idaho, costs are set to rise by over 4,000%.

The average premium for Pennsylvanians on Pennie will *double.*

Our neighbors can't afford this Republican health care crisis. https://t.co/cAmnHMNGm1

I'm fighting to save health care for millions of Americans and stop premiums from skyrocketing for millions more.

Pennie, Pennsylvania's Affordable Care Act market, is expecting premiums to rise by 102 PERCENT.

Republicans should bring the House back and end this madness today. https://t.co/9GGnDaiV1l

Even if you do not get health care through the Affordable Care Act, Medicaid, or Medicare, the Republican health care crisis will still raise your costs.

Trump's cuts are so massive that hospitals will close, and insurance companies will have to shift costs onto everyone. https://t.co/YxY1AqfGEh
The expert in question, Senator Rick Scott, oversaw one of the largest Medicare frauds in American history. https://t.co/KyHJrFbAp6

My position is clear: I want to protect health care coverage and keep premiums from rising for Pennsylvanians.

Republicans are flailing because the only thing that motivates them is enriching their billionaire donors, not helping working Americans. https://t.co/f9beZvAqg7
